entries.title: Monkey troop learning to crack nuts with stones
entries.description: A ring of semi-transparent monkey spheres moves on a light forest floor, where one labeled monkey learns to lift and drop a stone box on nut spheres causing them to split, with nearby monkeys gradually copying the motion, changing color from gray to bright green as they adopt the tool and leaving faint trails when they successfully crack nuts.
